verdict: REJECT — python-docx/PDF mismatch is a fatal technical error

key_findings.1_fatal_pdf_gap: python-docx cannot open PDFs. Pipeline dies on first PDF. Need pdfplumber/pymupdf + OCR for scans.
key_findings.2_manual_download_fragile: Manual bulk download makes Patrick a permanent file mule. Consider SharePoint REST/Graph API sync script (45 min).
key_findings.3_scope_incoherent: 50 newest + 2-3 years context requirement are contradictory. Newest 50 gives zero history for repeat customers.
key_findings.4_haiku_information_loss: No validation that Haiku extraction preserves nuances Sonnet needs for briefs. No reconciliation step.
key_findings.5_alternative: SharePoint sync script (Office365 SDK), single extraction layer (pdfplumber + docx), one Sonnet batch, drop Excel for SQLite.
